title: Enforce task dependencies and meaningful blocked states
interface: add_task_dependency and remove_task_dependency enforce finish-to-start/informational types, no cycles and required dependency readiness.
steps: Add dependency schema and commands with authorization on both records and no metadata leaks. Serialize graph edits sufficiently to prevent concurrent cycle creation.
Expose blocker/next-step information in task and contribution views; distinguish informational links from required gates.
Handle cancelled predecessors and explicit scope exceptions with reasons without waiving FIN/MCD rules.
checks: Self-edge, A→B→A cycle and concurrent inverse edges cannot corrupt graph.
Required unfinished predecessor blocks readiness; informational link does not.
Restricted predecessor shows only permitted neutral information and no private title/count leak.

title: Implement immutable handoff packages and acceptance
interface: submit_handoff, respond_to_handoff and accept_handoff bind receiver, package revision/manifest, criteria and agreed next task.
steps: Store offered package snapshots, sender/receiver, due date, states and resubmission revisions. Sender remains responsible until explicit acceptance.
Make acceptance atomic with immutable receipt, scoped grants and activation of the next agreed task; keep deliverable owner unchanged.
Recheck current receiver authority and original package state; audit transitions and emit outbox events.
checks: Changed file source cannot silently change the offered snapshot.
Accept racing cancellation has one valid outcome, not two contradictory states.
Decline/revision request creates no next task; repeated successful acceptance does not duplicate work.

title: Build incoming and outgoing handoff actions
interface: Screens consume immutable package/receipt and P17 transitions; overview gains authorized incoming handoffs and sender revision actions.
steps: Add package submission, file/criteria preview, accept/request-changes/decline/withdraw actions and readable history.
Show who currently owes the next action, proposed date and explicit acceptance state in Working Together/task detail.
Connect accepted next work to both committee views without changing accountability or granting unrelated records.
checks: Receiver can review package on mobile/keyboard and understands changes requested versus accepted.
Sender cannot mark own package accepted by editing UI state or replaying endpoint.
Overview deduplicates handoff/task events and removes resolved actions after refresh.

title: Create versioned request types and initial service catalog
interface: request_types points to immutable form_versions/workflow_versions, receiving service, primary/backup contacts and guest eligibility.
steps: Define stable request/form/stage identifiers and bounded schema types matching section 6. Seed general, FIN and MCD configurations with unconfirmed authority clearly flagged.
Build a plain-language catalog/read-only published form definition query and contact/lead-time/official-link display.
Protect typed financial/approval fields from arbitrary ordinary JSON and keep confidential custom fields restricted by type/payload classification.
checks: Published schema cannot be edited in place and an archived service cannot receive new live requests.
Unknown/conflicting field keys or unsafe executable conditions are rejected.
No generic form-definition read exposes private financial data, secrets or case notes.

title: Render and validate configured request forms
files: src/features/forms/*; supabase/functions or SQL validators; src/features/forms/validation.test.ts
interface: FormDefinition and typed field/condition evaluator supports fixed operators; browser and trusted submit validation agree on required fields and classifications.
steps: Implement accessible fields: text, numeric/currency, dates, choice/multichoice, checkbox, eligible member/unit, URL, file, repeatable lines.
Add required/help/error handling and bounded AND/OR equality/membership/numeric conditions. Preserve stable option IDs and display snapshots.
Implement trusted validation, field/section/line caps, eligible selector validation and handling of values in newly hidden fields. Do not trust client hidden values.
checks: Required conditional field omitted via direct API fails; client/server accept the same valid case.
50-field/10-section/100-line proposed limits and bounded condition nesting are enforced.
Keyboard/screen-reader errors target the correct control; malicious scripts/regex definitions never execute.

title: Implement tracked submission, revisions and requester views
interface: submit_request allocates shared per-term/service namespace IDs, freezes validated payload/asset manifest and creates pinned workflow instance; revise_request appends revision.
steps: Create requests, immutable revisions, tracking_counters and current state with same-term integrity. All FIN types share FIN counter, all MCD types share MCD counter.
Build draft/save/submit/revise/cancel/my-requests/tracking detail with next action, requested/accepted dates and history.
Pin form/workflow versions and create workflow assignment shell; P22 provides decision execution. Keep unconfigured authority visibly paused.
checks: Concurrent different MCD form submissions cannot both emit MCD-027; IDs never recycle.
Retry creates one submission; newer form publication does not rewrite prior payload/schema.
Another requester cannot read/edit private request data; submitted revision is immutable.

title: Execute authorized sequential review workflows
refs: F08/F09/F10; section 6 workflow engine and transition_request
interface: transition_request supports assigned sequential stages with one/all reviewers, pinned workflow/revision, revision route, conditions and external evidence; actor is session-derived.
steps: Implement assignments and append-only decisions; lock current stage/revision, check effective role, independence, expiry, required documents and idempotency.
Advance only after configured quorum; missing/revoked approver pauses for authorized reassignment. Stage labels do not change protected semantics.
Commit business state, decision, safe outcome, audit and outbox together. FIN/MCD typed authority hooks fail closed until their modules are installed.
checks: Unassigned/self/revoked approver, direct status update and stale-revision action fail.
All-reviewer stage cannot advance after only one decision; duplicate retries do not count twice.
Failed transition rolls back all effects; pinned old workflow remains consistent after new publication.

title: Build department triage and reviewer decision screens
interface: Authorized queue and assignment/decision UI use P22, exposing only reviewable version and permissible actions.
steps: Implement unassigned/assigned/aging/revision inboxes, reviewer assignment, requested versus accepted dates and safe triage notes.
Add review package preview, required reasons, revise/reject/approve/complete as allowed by server, and reassignment of lost authority.
Integrate actionable reviews and revisions into overview; distinguish operational request approval from FIN authorization and MCD release.
checks: Department associate sees assigned cases only unless explicitly granted broader scope.
Revoked reviewer loses action immediately after DB authorization check, even with an open page.
UI shows server conflict/validation and never optimistically labels a failed decision approved.

title: Create restricted finance revisions and exact money calculations
interface: finance_cases/revisions/lines and audited restricted reads separate from ordinary request JSON; PHP amounts use integer centavos and defined quantity rounding.
steps: Model costs, budget/expenses/reimbursement and fundraising/sales plan payloads, fund/purpose/beneficiary, pricing, forecast and governed evidence.
Implement trusted line/total validation with explicit quantity scale/rounding and safe serialization; never binary floating money. Keep sensitive joins out of ordinary views.
Bind finance revision to submitted request revision and immutable private evidence; define payload hash fields for later authorizations.
checks: PHP 0.10 + 0.20 equals 0.30; inconsistent totals, negative invalid inputs and out-of-range values fail.
Ordinary head/member cannot read another FIN case through API/search/counts/attachments.
Forecast sales do not create actual revenue or a payment record; source payload remains immutable.

title: Build cost and fundraising/sales request experiences
interface: Typed intake and reviewer detail use P24, showing requested/forecast/authorized/actual as distinct concepts.
steps: Build itemized cost/expense forms and fundraising/sales plan forms with prices, quantities, projected revenue/costs, terms, purpose and school evidence requirements.
Show confidential case contents only to eligible participants; show neutral gate summary to ordinary deliverable participants.
Explain that submission authorizes no commitment/payment and zero-cost fundraising still requires FIN review; expose missing requirements clearly.
checks: Zero-cost fundraiser takes FIN path rather than skipping approval.
Partial-line edits recompute exact totals with useful field errors.
Shared task link exposes safe status, never receipts, amounts or private financial title.

title: Enforce independent FIN authorization and revision invalidation
interface: FIN decision creates financial_authorization for exact revision/ceiling/purpose/conditions/expiry with required external authorization status.
steps: Connect typed FIN capability to P22. Block requester/beneficiary self-approval, require officially authorized alternate, and support partial approval without altering request.
Implement governed changes/new revision and superseded/expired/revoked authorization state with old decision preserved.
Build FIN decision/conditions/ceiling view and external evidence/not-required policy outcome. No invented threshold or PM substitute.
checks: Sole FIN approver's own case pauses rather than self-approves or routes to an unauthorized PM.
Amount/purpose/pricing/quantity/evidence change invalidates old readiness; harmless excluded metadata does not silently rewrite evidence.
Concurrent approve/reject or retry records one valid transition and preserves original request amount.

title: Add budget reservations and recorded actuals
interface: Optional budget_accounts and immutable reservation/release/reconciliation entries; actual expense/revenue records require evidence and do not process payments.
steps: Implement configured budget ceilings with atomic reservation on authorization, explicit cancellation release and reversing entries rather than destructive edits.
Record authorized actual expenses/revenue and evidence; detect duplicates and overrun requiring new review. Label booked/forecast/actual distinctly.
Expose restricted FIN ledger and safe delivery gate outcome without publishing balances/receipts to general core.
checks: Two simultaneous requests cannot reserve more than enabled available budget.
Cancelled authorization releases once; retry and reversal cannot double-credit budget.
Overrun is flagged/re-reviewed; projected sales never count as actual receipts and no payment integration exists.

title: Implement final publicity review with immutable evidence
interface: publicity_reviews bind final rendition manifest, copy/caption, credits, channel/use and intended date to request revision and MCD decision.
steps: Build final-publicity intake/reviewer pages separate from draft creative collaboration. Require frozen app evidence or exported rendition plus source link.
Use explicit MCD capability and P22 decisions; govern asset/caption/credit/channel/use changes through new revision, preserving old approvals.
Expose safe MCD gate results and independent FIN requirement for cost-bearing publicity. Do not post to social accounts.
checks: Mutable Canva/Drive URL alone cannot be accepted as final approval evidence.
Caption-only or source-asset replacement invalidates current publication readiness.
FIN approval cannot substitute for MCD, and MCD approval cannot clear unpaid/unapproved financial gates.

title: Unify deliverable acceptance across contributions and approvals
interface: Authoritative readiness/accept_deliverable checks required contribution acceptance, tasks/dependencies, criteria, valid revision-bound FIN/MCD and external authorization.
steps: Implement safe gate aggregation and derived readiness categories without treating task-percent complete as acceptance.
Wire deliverable owner submission and authorized final acceptance to actual checks; update list/detail/overview next action and blockers.
Apply protected policy triggers on work type even if an admin removes/renames a workflow label; record explicit permitted scope exceptions separately.
checks: All tasks Done with required handoff or FIN/MCD pending cannot accept deliverable.
A formerly accepted deliverable affected by a governed change shows required re-review according to documented reopening rule.
Unauthorized user learns no confidential amount/title through blocked reasons; clean authorized example completes end to end.

title: Deliver deduplicated in-app notifications and reliable jobs
interface: Transactional outbox -> authorized notifications with unique recipient/event key, read state, retries, dead-letter visibility and current access checks.
steps: Implement inbox/badge and required actionable events from tasks, agreements, handoffs, requests and decisions; handle already-resolved actions.
Dispatch after commit with bounded backoff, idempotency and persistent failure status. Keep external adapters disabled until their own steps.
Add read/unread preferences skeleton and safe notification text for restricted cases; prevent stale content after access revocation.
checks: Job crash/retry creates one visible notification, not duplicates.
Business decision remains committed if dispatch fails; failed queue is visible to custodian.
Revoked member cannot read stale restricted notification or use a deep link to regain access.

title: Build the shared calendar and explicit event exports
interface: calendar_events preserve source/visibility; single-event ICS and Add to Google Calendar are explicitly copies, not live sync.
steps: Build month/list/mobile event views with permitted core/committee events and source-linked milestones/deadlines.
Implement accurate Manila timed/all-day export, escaping ICS content, updates/cancellation labels and no duplicate source events.
Keep private finance/feedback/mentoring details out of shared calendars and defer automatic Google API integration to P53.
checks: Manila midnight, all-day dates and cancellation export correctly without date shifts.
Guest/other-unit user cannot see private event title/location through calendar counts.
Add-to-calendar is labeled copy and never claims continuous synchronization.
